name: Magical Girls Twin☆kle
source:
Main character gets invited to a rooftop after school. After a casual conversation Yayoi confesses that she is a magical girl. Of course protagonist takes it for a joke, but only for a minute till Yayoi repels a sudden attack of a monster. Yayoi is injured and needs to have the wound treated, so they come to protagonist's house. This day an unbelievable story of dating a magical girl begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
放学后，主人公受邀来到学校天台。闲聊几句后，弥生忽然向他坦白自己是一名魔法少女。主人公起初只当她在开玩笑，谁知话音刚落不过片刻，弥生便当面击退了骤然来袭的魔物。由于弥生在战斗中挂了彩、急需包扎伤口，两人便一同回到了主人公家中。自这一天起，一段与魔法少女恋爱的奇妙日常就此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
